title: Kannonji Castle

terrainReference.basis: Natural elevation datum between the two enclosures. Each modeled surviving stone line and staircase follows sampled GSI grades.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap native ruins and elevation survey

identities.name: Kannonji Castle
identities.address: Azuchicho Ishidera, Ōmihachiman, Shiga Prefecture, Japan

mapIdentity.scope: Named Honmaru and Hirai-maru, two surveyed stair routes, and mapped dry-stone retaining lines matched in their natural profile to the national one-metre terrain grid.

note: The exact Qualla photographs record broad uneven steps, large unmortared masonry, and the short Hirai gate flight. Prefectural archaeological documentation describes the surviving central enclosures and stone structures.
